Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes, reporting neck and low back
pain with associated muscle stiffness. The mechanism of the collision is consistent with the reported soft tissue injuries. Initial
examination showed reduced cervical and lumbar range of motion with paraspinal muscle tenderness, while neurological
screening and imaging-related assessments were within normal limits. No prior complaints or treatment involving the cervical or
lumbar regions are documented in the available history. Care followed a conventional course of manual therapy, thearpeutic
exercise, and home stretching instruction across 35 visits. Frequency of visits decreased steadily as symptoms resolved and
mobility improved, and discharge was planned once the patient reached functional goals. Billing records reflect a single charge
for each service rendered, with no duplicated entries. Prognosis is good with continued self-directed exercise.
</page>
